label: a8-05-thm-algebra-of-limits
tail:
ALLEGATION_VERDICT: NOT_REAL
ALLEGATION_LOCATION: items/thm-algebra-of-limits.md line 114; items/rem-sequence-conventions.md lines 164–193
ALLEGATION_ITEM_QUOTE: “so the same rules hold verbatim for sequences of rationals.”
ALLEGATION_TARGET_QUOTE: “The statements do transfer.” Also: “The proofs do not transfer by citation, and two places are why.”
ALLEGATION_REASONING: The judge conflated transfer of the theorem’s rules with reuse of its real-specific library citations. The item claims that the rules hold for rational sequences. The sibling expressly agrees that the statements transfer, while warning that the local proof citations cannot simply be reused unchanged. There is no contradiction.

OTHER_FINDINGS:
LOCATION: items/thm-algebra-of-limits.md line 60, Facts and Assumptions block, L1
QUOTE: “[L1] Convergence, quantified over rational”
DEFECT: This is a fatal citation-fidelity failure under the supplied standard. It replaces the cited definition with a descriptive fragment rather than stating the definition.
EVIDENCE: The cited def-real-limit gives the complete quantified convergence condition for a sequence of reals: for each positive rational tolerance there is a natural threshold after which every absolute error is below that tolerance. L1 omits the domain, threshold, eventual quantifier, inequality, and conclusion.
